rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Low-edge, fear-gripped tape (F&G ~39) with the majors churning sideways — exactly the setup where the strategy favors the liquid majors. BTC owns the only durable institutional bid: US spot BTC ETFs have logged ~5 straight sessions of inflows (~$850M since Aug 3), while ETH is dead money and SOL/XRP ETFs are bleeding or flat. BTC is holding firmly above $64k and pressing $65k. Asymmetric trigger: a clean break of $66-67k opens $68k then $69k; the ETF bid cushions downside. Canonical dashboard proxy FRESH this run (asOf 2026-08-10T11:53:08Z): BTC 65011.76, ETH 1916.80, SOL 76.86.
positions.driver: Closed prior SOL at 76.86 (canonical live) vs entry 76.41 for +63.10 (+0.59%) — SOL's momentum bet paid a small profit but stalled at the $77-78 pivot with NO ETF flow support and negative net flows. ROTATED into BTC as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick on a low-edge day: it has the strongest relative strength AND the most downside protection of the universe (5 straight days of ETF inflows, deepest liquidity), plus near-term catalysts in Fed guidance and fresh ETF flow prints. Wins vs runners-up: SOL (76.86) is momentum-only and rejecting resistance with ETF outflows; ETH (1916.80) still can't convert inflows into price and sits mid-range; XRP (~1.03) has seen ETF inflows dry to near-zero and is pinned near its $1 floor. BTC is the highest-quality asymmetric hold when the tape offers no clear edge.
positions.risks: BTC's edge here is quality/protection, not explosive upside — on a fear tape it can keep grinding sideways and produce little. A hawkish Fed surprise or a break below $64k support risks a slide toward $63k then $62.5k. ETF-inflow streaks can reverse abruptly and remove the bid. Hard stop 59810.82 (-8%).
